campaign: Transfer audio.cpp behavior into reusable Go audio operations and prove the CPU ingest-train-evaluate-serve lifecycle before broader architectures and CUDA
doctrine: Work and commit only in overgo_audiocpp; do not push. At the boundary after an audio commit and before the next implementation step, snapshot current master once, prepare and gate its first-parent-target merge if needed, review its plan for relevant owner/API changes, and retain this audio plan. Do not chase master during a slice or recursively merge after merge commits. Honor an explicit stop before beginning another merge or slice. Existing sync-* IDs are retained for completion-history integrity but now identify the concrete work in their titles, not synchronization-only commits; no rows are declared completed by this replan. Master owns broad text benchmarking and platform cleanup; this campaign proves their shared owners on audio, without importing master's task list. Each downloaded reference is a pinned behavioral oracle, never a linked runtime or permanent product dependency. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the first offline oracle, native Safetensors Nemotron 3.5 ASR the second and streaming oracle, and FireRedVAD the segmentation oracle; the incompatible Q8 GGUF remains rejected. Pin source revision, artifact, fixture and transform identities with independent boundary traces and explicit tolerances. Reuse audiodsp, safetensors, tokenizer, hostmath/tensor, modelrecipe, capabilityruntime, dataset, evaluation, runrecord, trainingprogram and trainingworkflow. Use concrete operation-named components, including those used by one recipe; model identity, tensor names, geometry, padding, normalization, ties and composition belong in declarations, never model-family execution branches. Add only a demonstrated missing operation with its real consumer in the same slice. Preserve one inference/training forward path and the existing loader, scheduler, optimizer, checkpoint and persistence owners. No general-purpose graph engine, parallel registry, dataset cache, service or verifier framework. Migrate callers and delete displaced paths together; measure API/state/buffer reduction alongside parity, not line count alone. First correct measurement semantics, then bounded dataset traversal and a real pinned CPU baseline, then frozen-base adaptation, exact stop and resume, evaluation, publication, reload and authenticated serving. The first adapter is identity-initialized on final hidden features before the frozen CTC projection; preserve tied weights and optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state. First lifecycle acceptance includes VAD composition, pre/post WER/resource evidence and complete OvergoDB lineage, but does not wait for encoder gradients, another ASR architecture, streaming ASR, voice or CUDA. Keep those capabilities as later work. Dataset preparation and VAD do not depend on a trained recognizer. Decode actual samples, account for every rejection, and quarantine policy-invalid, silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped or non-finite inputs. Reference text never enters prediction. Use pinned LibriSpeech clean first; the historical silent AMI materialization remains quarantined until its exact source/transformation is established, and isolated-store success does not repair the historical inspection batch-key finding. Reuse source-addressed Parquet/Arrow traversal and immutable outputs for scoring; do not eagerly copy a corpus or cache predictions for timing. Performance repetitions execute fresh inference, identify each attempt, and separate cold load, warm execution and publication spans. Unknown counters stay absent; boundary Go heap samples are not process peak memory, and unavailable peak/VRAM evidence cannot support a memory or promotion claim. Profiling is separate from timed runs. CPU remains the numerical authority; eligible CPU work proceeds while GPU capacity is occupied, and CUDA follows measured bottlenecks through kernels/manifest.json. Commit gates may use required GPU scope; unsupported or unavailable device execution never passes. Static DSP parity is not ASR parity, transport chunking is not native streaming, and segment offsets are not word timestamps. Every verify names one exact acceptance test with mandatory subchecks: add it to the existing owner as part of that step, run through cmd/plan -verify or the gate, require nonempty executed cases, and fail on missing artifacts or skipped subchecks. The acceptance names are planned work, not claims that the tests already exist. Report failures, denominators and no-gain outcomes; promotion requires the existing quality/resource policy. API consolidation follows existing owners: one bounded media.DecodeAudio path for encoded waveform ingestion, one shared PCM representation when synthesis is migrated, and distinct typed transcription/generated-audio artifacts. Keep ASR, synthesis, VAD, alignment and speaker operations separate; do not add an umbrella audio service or generic optional-field result. Reuse existing recipe selection, residency, cancellation, operation tracking and publication in serving. Preserve AudioStreamCursor progress/checkpoint ownership and AudioStreamSession concurrency/residency ownership. Consolidation migrates every actual caller and deletes displaced APIs in the same slice; prove unchanged accepted samples and explicit refusal semantics, not only fewer exported names.

items.title: Expose authenticated transcription and streaming through the native server

steps.title: Expose the admitted recipe through authenticated POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
steps.rationale: Reuse workspace authentication, upload limits, recipe selection, operations and cancellation. The route invokes the existing transcriber; it cannot implement decoding or inference again. Initially refuse unsupported formats, timestamps and streaming. Prove real successful transcription plus authentication, invalid input, limit and cancellation failures. Later segmented recipes use this same route. Bind the existing transcriber through current capability/workflow and model-session owners; share load/residency, operation tracking, timing and publication rather than wrapping them in an audio service. Keep the HTTP handler limited to protocol adaptation and retain distinct transcription output. Reuse the consolidated bounded decoder and task-specific admission policy.

steps.title: Bind verified native recognizer state to existing bounded audio sessions
steps.rationale: Adapt the second oracle's verified state to capabilityruntime.OpenAudioStream; one owner controls retained buffers, discontinuities, checkpoint/restart and finalization. No growing-prefix offline re-inference, second scheduler or general session framework. Prove native state continuation, declared chunk semantics, bounded retained bytes and cancellation before HTTP transport.

steps.title: Serve partial and final transcripts through the existing session and transport owners
steps.rationale: Mandatory subchecks cover partial/final ordering, native chunk semantics, backpressure, disconnect cancellation, restart, shutdown and resource bounds using actual recognition. Measure first-partial/finalization latency separately from total real-time factor. Reuse admission, transcript persistence and authenticated route policy.

items.title: Prove Overgo's universal trainer on the native audio route

steps.title: Repair canonical audio-inspection replay without rewriting immutable source evidence
steps.rationale: Reproduce the historical inspection batch-key conflict through dataset's existing inspection/publication owner. Repair canonical idempotent replay, prove identical replay has no change and conflicting content refuses, and verify the actual historical identity before closing its finding. A fresh isolated store is only a fixture, not historical repair. Do not clear the quarantined AMI materialization based on a different source.

steps.title: Register LibriSpeech and share bounded source traversal between training and evaluation
steps.rationale: Reuse dataset/trainingdata Parquet/Arrow traversal, deterministic split and resume owners. Bind shard/row/column identity and target-isolated transcripts; decode once per pass, account for rejects, and resume the exact next record. Replace evaluation's eager os.ReadFile corpus array and full payload clones with the same bounded source traversal. Persist provenance by reference; transformed features remain optional transform-keyed artifacts, not another corpus store. Prove bounded live payloads, split disjointness, resume, corruption/silence refusal and cancellation on a nonempty pinned corpus.

steps.title: Record a real pinned CPU quality and resource baseline before training
steps.rationale: Invoke the concrete admitted recipe through evaluate's existing transcription resource manifest on a nonempty source-addressed LibriSpeech split plus explicit negative controls. Require fresh attempts, source/model/recipe/environment identities, WER/CER, complete failure denominators and corrected resource availability. Report cold load and warm execution separately. Faked executors and stored transcripts cannot establish inference performance. This baseline supplies later training and benchmarking; do not recreate it for each consumer.

steps.title: Bind CTC loss and gradients to the universal trainer's existing objective owner
steps.rationale: Implement only missing CTC math, using independent oracle values and finite differences for blank/repeated labels, variable lengths and impossible alignments. Define refusal/reduction semantics explicitly and derive workspace from sequence geometry. Reuse existing parameter and loss contracts; no audio trainer, duplicate forward graph or speculative encoder tape.

steps.title: Train one identity-initialized hidden-feature projection with shared CTC loss and the base model frozen
steps.rationale: Use one square linear adapter on the final encoder hidden features, before the existing frozen CTC projection. Derive its width from the loaded hidden tensor and initialize it to identity, with no bias or additional activation required for the first proof. Reuse hostmath linear forward, LinearBackwardInput through the frozen final projection, and LinearWeightGradient for adapter updates; do not retain an encoder backward trace. The mutable matrix is hidden-width squared, not vocabulary-size squared. Bind CTC to trainingprogram and the existing optimizer, parameter-selection and checkpoint owners; include weights, gradients, optimizer workspace and forward buffers in the memory admission. Independently verify identity-logit preservation, CTC loss/gradients, repeated labels, blanks, lengths, impossible-alignment policy and unchanged base bytes. Preserve the shared final/intermediate projection; never untie it or update feedback weights under a frozen-base claim. Existing gated per-layer adapters and two-model bridge fitting have different semantics; do not fabricate side inputs or a second model to force reuse. Store base, adapter, placement and recipe identities. If held-out WER does not improve, report the result and use the planned internal/full-encoder training path rather than adding an unplanned adapter stack.

steps.title: Publish and reload the adapted recipe through existing checkpoint and artifact owners
steps.rationale: Bind base, hidden-feature adapter, placement, tied-parameter identity and recipe to the universal trainer's checkpoint/publication contract. Reload must preserve logits and transcripts without copying the frozen base into each adapter checkpoint. Prove digest mismatch, missing component, incompatible placement and incomplete-publication refusal; introduce no audio-specific checkpoint format.

steps.title: Prove interrupted and uninterrupted adapter training follow the same trajectory
steps.rationale: Reuse trainingworkflow resume ownership. Compare next batch identity, parameters, optimizer moments, random and scheduler state, loss and subsequent updates after a real stop/restart. Missing or mismatched state must fail, not restart silently. A loadable weight file alone is insufficient.

steps.title: Prove the CPU audio lifecycle: adapt, resume, evaluate, publish, reload and serve the same recipe
steps.rationale: TestASRCPUClosedLoop owns the integration proof using existing trainingworkflow, evaluation and server owners; it is not a new orchestrator. Its mandatory subchecks execute the pinned real-artifact CPU path, a nonempty admitted training/held-out split, nonzero updates, interrupted/uninterrupted trajectory equality, VAD-composed admission, pre/post WER/resource fitness, artifact publication/reload and authenticated HTTP transcription. Each stage binds its predecessor's actual artifact IDs and accounts for failures. Missing prerequisites refuse rather than skip; mocks, cached transcripts, absent subchecks or unrelated train-lane tests cannot satisfy acceptance. Reuse earlier immutable prediction records only when identities match; explicitly rerun training, resume, reload and serving behavior. Do not wait for CUDA, full encoder gradients, second-model or voice work. Record no-gain results honestly; promotion requires the existing quality/resource policy.

steps.title: Add only missing common backward operations required by the admitted encoder
steps.rationale: Read the oracle end-to-end and inventory existing hostmath/tensor backward operations. For each missing operation, bind an actual encoder consumer and independently verify gradients, including shared intermediate-feedback/final-projection contributions. Trace only what backward needs, derive workspace, and preserve the inference forward implementation. No duplicate tensor engine.

steps.title: Extend the same forward graph to internal adapters and full-encoder CTC training
steps.rationale: Retain full training capability without placing every encoder gradient on the first adaptation path. Reuse the existing forward and common backward owners; add gradients only for missing operators, checking each against independent oracle or finite differences. Accumulate shared-parameter contributions from both intermediate feedback and final projection into one optimizer-owned parameter. Internal adapters still require gradients through their downstream frozen operations; freezing is not permission to omit that path. Extend the same exact-resume and pre/post WER/resource evidence to full or internally adapted training, with no second trainer or checkpoint format.

items.title: Deliver native speech segmentation, then expand shared speech analysis

steps.title: Bind the segmentation artifact to common frontend and recurrent operations
steps.rationale: Use the pinned FireRedVAD oracle to derive checkpoint tensor declarations, normalization and recurrent-state geometry. Reuse verified DSP and host operations; only semantics absent from those owners justify new operation-named code. Prove feature/probability parity and no-speech controls on nonempty source-bound fixtures; no FireRed-specific mathematical dispatch.

steps.title: Prove bounded streaming VAD, restart and segment-boundary parity
steps.rationale: Reuse the offline VAD forward operations and capabilityruntime.OpenAudioStream. Prove offline/stream boundary behavior, discontinuity, finalization, checkpoint/restart and all-zero no-speech controls against the pinned oracle. Consume and retire the corresponding staged-surface declaration in the same slice. Attribute the AMI negative control only to its exact historical materialization.

steps.title: Derive scored word alignment from verified frame emissions and transcript tokens
steps.rationale: Use common CTC/frame alignment over stored emissions and typed transcripts where supported. Define blank/repeat, silence, sample-offset and token-to-word semantics from the oracle; refuse unsupported alignment rather than treating segment offsets as word timestamps. Score timestamp errors against actual annotations with complete denominators. This does not require live model switching.

steps.title: Add speaker-turn attribution using verified common embedding and clustering operations
steps.rationale: Reuse aligned transcripts, VAD segments and the existing typed speech-turn contract. Elect a pinned executable speaker oracle and annotated corpus, derive missing operations from that evidence, and report attribution/boundary error plus transcript preservation. Keep speaker metadata in declarations; no unscored heuristic or second analysis pipeline.

items.title: Compose validated audio primitives into native operational recipes

steps.title: Compose VAD segments with the existing short-clip transcriber
steps.rationale: Implement bounded segment traversal and assembly in the existing recipe owner, preserving exact sample offsets, declared overlap/finalization policy and source lineage. Reuse the admitted short-clip call unchanged. Compare whole-record output to the oracle and refuse unsupported duration/memory budgets; do not build another decode-normalize-infer pipeline.

steps.title: Bind the same segmented recipe to dataset and authenticated serving consumers
steps.rationale: Select the verified composed recipe through existing bindings in both consumers and persist segment-level lineage. Prove nonempty valid input, silent/corrupt refusal, transcript assembly and identical recipe identity across offline and HTTP use. Delete displaced consumer-specific segmentation policy in the same slice.

items.title: Prove the substrate with a second ASR architecture and live operations

steps.title: Execute the second ASR artifact offline through common operations and declarations
steps.rationale: Use native Safetensors Nemotron as the actual second consumer. Reuse loader, frontend, tokenizer, task/result and evaluation owners; add only independently evidenced missing operations with this consumer. Prove layer/logit/token/transcript parity and family-free execution on both models. Reject the incompatible Q8 GGUF rather than adding a loader shortcut.

steps.title: Prove the second architecture's native streaming state and timestamp semantics
steps.rationale: Use the pinned native streaming oracle for feature/state/logit/token traces, chunk boundaries, finalization and timestamp tokens. Store geometry and composition in declarations and keep mathematical operations common. This establishes recognition semantics; capabilityruntime and HTTP bindings follow as separate real consumers, not a second model runtime.

steps.title: Switch between admitted ASR recipes through the existing live-model lifecycle
steps.rationale: Prove sequential switch, predecessor rollback, artifact mismatch refusal and resource release using both real models and the common swap/lifecycle owner. Bind requests to the selected immutable recipe; no audio-only registry, pool or placement service.

steps.title: Prove bounded concurrent audio service through shared placement and scheduling
steps.rationale: Reuse the store-derived smoke matrix and existing scheduler. Mandatory real-artifact cases cover both ASR models, concurrent request isolation, resource admission, cancellation, switch during active work, restart and complete release. Do not accept a generic text-only smoke run as audio evidence; collect audio case identities and failure denominators.

items.title: Consolidate speech synthesis and admit broader audio generation

steps.title: Consolidate existing synthesis outputs and sessions onto common audio contracts
steps.rationale: Migrate executable PocketTTS inference to shared source/output lineage and session lifecycle, preserving existing golden results. Reuse synthesis math unchanged and delete displaced policy/call paths atomically. Admission is task-specific: ASR silence rejection must not be blindly applied to valid synthesis silence. Consolidate speechsynth.Audio and media.DecodedAudio around one in-memory PCM/format representation; preserve caller ownership and avoid new copies. Keep persistent GeneratedAudio/AudioReference separate from in-memory samples, and verify the recipe-to-HTTP encoded-audio boundary. Migrate all synthesis callers and delete displaced types/schema paths only with explicit artifact migration where existing records require it. Do not merge synthesis with recognition or force offline execution through streaming.

steps.title: Bind synthesis training and publication to the proven universal lifecycle
steps.rationale: Retain existing PocketTTS training behavior while reusing checkpoint/resume, evaluation and recipe publication owners proven by ASR. Verify uninterrupted/resumed updates, reload and synthesis quality; delete duplicated lifecycle policy without forcing incompatible loss or admission semantics into one abstraction.

steps.title: Elect one executable voice capability and record its reusable-operation gaps
steps.rationale: Choose multilingual synthesis or voice conversion from executable, licensed artifact/oracle evidence. Run a bounded pinned reference and identify the exact additional speaker/codec/conditioning operations and a falsifiable quality check before production code. A failed election records a refusal and does not silently satisfy the dependent port.

steps.title: Deliver the elected voice capability through common conditioning and codec operations
steps.rationale: Port only elected missing operations and bind them to existing synthesis, speaker, evaluation and training contracts. Prove source/conditioning identity, independent output parity, quality denominators and a real training/update path. No model-family executor or parallel synthesis service. Missing admitted election is a failure.

steps.title: Elect a generative-audio oracle and test reuse of existing DiT and codec operations
steps.rationale: Bound artifact intake and CPU-readable component traces before allocating device work. Identify an executable licensed model, quality assertions, conditioning/codec semantics and a credible universal-training route; compare with existing DiT owners. No production package is created by election. Reject unsupported candidates with evidence, leaving dependent execution unavailable.

steps.title: Run the elected generative-audio forward and training feasibility probe
steps.rationale: Execute the admitted artifact through reused DiT/media owners, compare independent boundary traces and media quality, and measure wall/memory against its model-native reference. Exercise a bounded nonzero training update through the universal trainer. Stop expansion if parity, quality or resource acceptance fails; no production claim from an election alone. Does not require an unrelated voice-conversion port.

items.title: Accelerate the elected ASR model through manifest-owned CUDA

steps.title: Measure and simplify CPU audio hotspots before introducing device paths
steps.rationale: Profile separately from timed repetitions on the pinned baseline. Prefer removal of repeated decode, copies, allocations and duplicated transforms over pooling, batching or new dispatch. Reuse existing FFT/common operators where independently equivalent; direct DFT remains a numerical reference, not a speed claim. Accept changes only with unchanged boundary/quality evidence and measured wall/live-memory results. A measured no-change decision is valid; no speculative optimization.

steps.title: Bind only measured missing audio operations through existing CUDA manifests
steps.rationale: Use CPU profiles and existing kernel contracts to select acceleration. Reuse manifest entries and generated ABI; no model-specific kernels or manual ABI. Check current compiler/toolkit support before execution: the earlier CUDA 12.9/MSVC 19.51 failure is not a permanent assumption or passing evidence. Defer occupied-device work while eligible CPU work remains.

steps.title: Verify accelerated operation and gradient parity before full recipe promotion
steps.rationale: Compare actual CUDA forward/backward operators to independent CPU authority on the admitted shapes, tied parameters and boundary fixtures. Derive workspace and test cancellation/cleanup. Run manifest-derived device and race coverage as required; unavailable device execution fails. Bind operator evidence to the same recipe, not synthetic unrelated shapes only.

steps.title: Prove complete CUDA inference and training against the CPU recipe
steps.rationale: On identical artifacts and datasets compare activations, logits, transcripts, WER, adapter/full-training updates where admitted, and resume. Record wall, real-time factor, host peak availability and VRAM with actual compiler/driver/device identities. Require applicable device-lane evidence and quality/resource policy before promotion; CPU remains supported.

items.title: Measure audio capability and resource fitness through existing evaluation and routing owners

steps.title: Extend the pinned audio baseline to held-out quality and admission coverage
steps.rationale: Reuse native transcription suites, stored source identities and target-isolated predictions. Cover admitted duration/speaker slices and explicit silence/corrupt controls with WER/CER, normalization, failure denominators and artifact/protocol identity. Reuse the first CPU baseline; add only missing held-out coverage. Report domain limits of LibriSpeech clean. Broad MMLU/text-model runs remain master's work, not an audio prerequisite.

steps.title: Measure repeated audio baselines and derive comparison envelopes
steps.rationale: Reuse the corrected resource suite across source-derived duration/segment shapes and admitted recipes. Isolate load, warm inference and training timing; keep profiling separate. Use repeated observations to derive variation envelopes and retain unknown peak memory/VRAM. No copied perf-sweep runner or arbitrary fitted thresholds.

steps.title: Judge audio quality, latency and memory together through shared fitness policy
steps.rationale: Compare baseline and candidate on matched artifact, corpus, protocol, hardware and measurement scopes. Exercise no-gain, regression, unavailable-dimension and approved tradeoff cases through the existing multidimensional fitness owner. Report capability and API/state/buffer changes beside WER/CER and resource results; a faster but less accurate candidate cannot silently win.

steps.title: Record real audio routing observations through the existing observation owner
steps.rationale: Use both admitted ASR recipes and their measured quality/resource evidence. Bind source, context, selected recipe, candidate set, outcome and resource availability to stored observations. Verify refusal on missing identity and incomplete candidate evidence; no audio-specific router or fabricated routing trace.

steps.title: Evaluate audio counterfactual routing and live safety on recorded observations
steps.rationale: Replay real recorded audio observations through existing routing, rollout and safety-window owners. Verify selection, insufficient-evidence refusal, regression quarantine and predecessor rollback against matched quality/resource evidence. Distinguish counterfactual replay from actual live outcomes and retain complete denominators.

items.title: Prove audio consumers recover through shared durability and control-plane owners

steps.title: Prove CPU audio cancellation releases buffers, operations and dataset cursors
steps.rationale: Use actual offline transcription and adapter-training consumers to interrupt decode, inference and data iteration. Assert cancellation propagation, terminal operation state, bounded goroutine lifetime and resource release through existing owners. This CPU check does not wait for native streaming or CUDA.

steps.title: Recover interrupted audio checkpoint publication and damaged store copies
steps.rationale: Extend the existing exact-resume evidence to interruption at publication boundaries. Exercise torn-tail recovery, restore and supported compaction through store owners on explicitly isolated copies only; verify predecessor recipe availability, no partial activation and resumed data/update identity. Existing platform store drills supply shared mechanics; never damage canonical model/dataset/checkpoint stores.

steps.title: Prove audio candidate quarantine and atomic predecessor rollback
steps.rationale: Exercise the existing promotion/circuit-breaker owner with actual audio quality/resource refusal evidence. Verify no partial activation, in-flight request recipe identity, rollback and evidence-based re-entry. No second audio promotion policy.

steps.title: Recover audio peer failures and durable workflow obligations
steps.rationale: Use existing remote streaming adapters and workflow obligations to exercise peer timeout, partial response, cancellation and restart reconciliation. Require an audio request/output lineage chain and exactly one terminal obligation outcome; generic control-plane build success does not count.

steps.title: Verify the audio gate derives applicable acceptance and resource scope
steps.rationale: On an isolated repository fixture, verify plan/gate scope for representative audio declaration, CPU execution and kernel changes. Reuse manifest-derived test/device selection, and reject unexecuted or skipped audio acceptance. Record measured admission cost using existing phase telemetry. Do not create another gate or broaden this into master's gate redesign.

steps.title: Recover interrupted audio gate preparation on an isolated checkout
steps.rationale: Use existing prepare/recover/watchdog owners on a disposable copy of the audio history/store, never the active worktree. Interrupt preparation and verification; prove recovery preserves dirty user changes, plan identities and completion authority without false completion or duplicate commit. Report phase wall times against measured local baselines. Reopen shared gate defects only with a reproduced audio blocker, not an unbounded merge-depth campaign.
